modFieldsFormsNoteBody.message: Forms Settings configure structure and behavior only, not form content. Form sections/questions are edited in the Form Builder. Responses and execution belong in Form Responses and Work interfaces.

modFieldsOrgsNoteBody.message: This configures business organizations (Customer, Partner, Vendor), not tenant organizations. Tenant organization settings are managed in Platform Settings.

modFieldsTasksNoteBody.message: Tasks Settings configure structure only, never work. Task lists, completion, time tracking, and automation belong in Surfaces and Work interfaces.

modFieldsEventsNoteBody.message: Events Settings handle structure and constraints only. Scheduling, calendars, execution, audit workflows, and geo tracking belong in Surfaces and Work interfaces.

modFieldsItemsNoteBody.message: Items Settings configure structure only. Items are supporting/secondary entities used primarily in sales contexts.

modFieldsPlatformOwnedBody.message: This is a shared platform capability owned by the platform. It cannot be deleted, renamed, or modified. Applications can use this capability, but they cannot change its core definition.

modFieldsFormPermMatrixIntro.message: This matrix explains configuration authority in Form Settings. Permissions are explanatory only and do not enforce access.

modFieldsFormPermMatrixEnforcement.message: Actual enforcement happens at API & surface level. This mirrors Event Execution permission design.

modFieldsOrgsStatusTypesDesc.message: Configure organization types and status picklists. These are app-scoped semantics that control workflow states.

modFieldsOrgsStatusTypesNote.message: Organization types and status values are app-scoped. Changes here affect how organizations are classified and tracked within specific applications (Sales, Helpdesk, etc.).

modFieldsOrgTypesDesc.message: Enable or disable organization types. These are business classifications used to categorize organizations.

modFieldsOrgTypesFootnote.message: Organization types are business classifications. Disabling a type hides it from selection but does not affect existing organizations.

modFieldsStatusForCustomer.message: Status values for organizations with type "Customer"

modFieldsStatusForPartner.message: Status values for organizations with type "Partner"

modFieldsStatusForVendor.message: Status values for organizations with type "Vendor"

modFieldsNoStatusValues.message: No status values configured. Click "Add Value" to create one.

modFieldsCustomerStatusFootnote.message: Customer status values are app-scoped (Sales app). Disabled values remain in the system but are hidden from selection.

modFieldsPartnerStatusFootnote.message: Partner status values are app-scoped (Sales app). Disabled values remain in the system but are hidden from selection.

modFieldsVendorStatusFootnote.message: Vendor status values are app-scoped (Sales app). Disabled values remain in the system but are hidden from selection.

modFieldsTasksStatusPriorityDesc.message: Task lifecycle values are configured in Field Configurations. Select the Status or Priority field to edit options.

modFieldsItemsStatusTypesDesc.message: Configure item types and status picklists. These control how items are classified and their lifecycle states.

modFieldsItemTypesDesc.message: Enable or disable item types. These are business classifications used to categorize items.

modFieldsItemTypesFootnote.message: Item types are business classifications. Disabling a type hides it from selection but does not affect existing items.

modFieldsItemStatusFootnote.message: Status values control item lifecycle. At least one status value must remain enabled.

modFieldsEventStatusDesc.message: Event statuses are system-controlled and required for lifecycle execution.

modFieldsEventStatusesLockedBody.message: Planned, Completed, and Cancelled are locked. They cannot be renamed, deleted, reordered, or disabled in Settings.

modFieldsEventStatusPicklistDesc.message: Visibility-only view of the system status values.

modFieldsEventStatusTransitionsFootnote.message: Status transitions happen from Work interfaces (for example, complete or cancel actions), not from Settings.

modFieldsRolesRulesDesc.message: Configure role requirements, geo rules, and form-linking rules per event type.

modFieldsRolesRulesNote.message: This tab configures constraints only. Assignment, workflow transitions, and execution behavior are handled in Work interfaces.

modFieldsRoleRequirementsDesc.message: Configure which roles are mandatory for each event type. This controls field requirements, not role assignment.

modFieldsRoleRequirementsImportant.message: These checkboxes configure field requirements (which roles must be assigned), not role assignment itself. Role assignment happens in Work interfaces when creating/editing events.

modFieldsMeetingAuditorOptional.message: Auditor field is optional for Meeting events.

modFieldsMeetingReviewerOptional.message: Reviewer field is optional for Meeting events.

modFieldsMeetingCorrectiveOwnerOptional.message: Corrective Owner field is optional for Meeting events.

modFieldsAuditAuditorRequired.message: Auditor is always required for audit events. This cannot be changed.

modFieldsInternalAuditReviewerOptional.message: Reviewer is optional for Internal Audit events (self-review allowed).

modFieldsExternalAuditReviewerRequired.message: Reviewer is always required for External Audit — Single Org events. This cannot be changed.

modFieldsExternalAuditBeatReviewerOption.message: Reviewer is optional for External Audit Beat events.

modFieldsFieldSalesAuditorOptional.message: Auditor field is optional for Field Sales Beat events.

modFieldsFieldSalesReviewerOptional.message: Reviewer field is optional for Field Sales Beat events.

modFieldsFieldSalesCorrectiveOwnerOption.message: Corrective Owner field is optional for Field Sales Beat events.

modFieldsGeoRulesDesc.message: Configure geo requirements per event type. This controls whether geo tracking is required, not geo tracking execution.

modFieldsGeoRulesImportant.message: These settings configure geo requirements (whether geo tracking must be enabled), not geo tracking execution. Geo tracking execution (GPS capture, radius validation) belongs in Work interfaces.

modFieldsGeoRequiredAudit.message: Geo is always required for audit events and cannot be disabled.

modFieldsGeoConfigurable.message: Geo requirement can be configured for this event type.

modFieldsFormLinkingRulesDesc.message: Configure form linking eligibility per event type. This controls whether forms can be linked, not form assignment or execution.

modFieldsFormLinkingImportant.message: These settings configure form linking eligibility (whether forms can be linked to events), not form assignment or execution. Form assignment and execution belong in Work interfaces.

modFieldsFormsAlwaysLinkedAudit.message: Forms can always be linked to audit events.

modFieldsEnableFormLinking.message: Enable or disable form linking for this event type.

modFieldsRequireFormOnCreationDesc.message: Require a form to be linked when creating audit events of this type.

modFieldsPreventUnlinkingAfterStartDesc.message: Prevent unlinking forms from events that have been started (checked in).

modFieldsLogicRulesDesc.message: Configure form behavior, scoring, and automation rules. Form content is edited in the Form Builder.

modFieldsOutcomesDesc.message: Configure form outcomes, reporting metrics, and post-submission signals. Form content is edited in the Form Builder.

modFieldsCapOutcomesHint.message: Configure audit rules, reporting metrics, and signals

modFieldsCapExecutionLockedHint.message: Managed in Event Execution / Work interfaces

modFieldsCapWorkflowLockedHint.message: Managed in Audit Workflow / Work components
